channel.title: Wil Massara | Blog
channel.description: Youth leadership, Gen Z at work, co-design and education, from Gen Z keynote speaker Wil Massara.

item.title: Why 'leaders of tomorrow' is the most damaging phrase in education
item.description: Calling students the leaders of tomorrow tells them to wait. 30% of Australians are under 25 and they are already leading.

item.title: Leadership literacy: why leadership should be taught like reading
item.description: Schools mandate maths and English from day one and leave leadership until the end, or out completely.

item.title: Co-design with young people: a practical guide for schools and councils
item.description: Most youth consultation is tokenistic even when it is well-intentioned.

item.title: Why banning AI in schools fails students (and what to do instead)
item.description: Schools that ban AI are not protecting students. They are sending them into a workforce that has already changed.

item.title: How to manage Gen Z employees, from a Gen Z CEO
item.description: Most advice on managing Gen Z is written by people who have never been one.

item.title: What principals actually want from a school speaker (and what they hate)
item.description: After speaking to students and staff across 1,500+ schools, here is what principals want from a school speaker: relevance, respect for the approval chain,.

item.title: What Gen Z values in the workplace, backed by research
item.description: Purpose, flexibility, growth, real inclusion, tech that works and a voice that matters.

item.title: 7 reasons hiring young people changed the way I lead
item.description: Energy, digital fluency, adaptability, fresh eyes, a different kind of loyalty, doing a lot with a little and real authenticity.

item.title: 5 steps to motivate Gen Z staff
item.description: Purpose, growth, flexibility, feedback and recognition. Five practical changes that keep Gen Z employees motivated and committed, from a leader who is Gen Z.
